# InterPore Abstracts Explorer

> An explorer for 8,115 abstracts of the annual meetings of the International Society for Porous Media (InterPore), 2016–2026: flow, transport and mechanics in natural and industrial porous media, grouped by topic. InterPore publishes abstracts, not full papers; each entry links to its page on events.interpore.org (2018 on) or its page in the book of abstracts (2016, 2017).

- Abstracts are the authors' own text as submitted; this site adds topics, a map and similar-abstract links (from text embeddings), nothing written by an AI.
- No abstracts are online for the 2009–2015 meetings; they appear only in the History view.
- Each abstract has a page at `https://mralbu.github.io/interpore-papers/#<ID>` (e.g. `#IP2024-164`).

## Topics

- [Fractures, geomechanics and numerical methods](https://mralbu.github.io/interpore-papers/llms/fractures-geomechanics-and-numerical-methods.txt): 1047 abstracts. Keywords: fracture, fractures, fractured, numerical, matrix, hydraulic
- [Capillarity, wettability and two-phase displacement](https://mralbu.github.io/interpore-papers/llms/capillarity-wettability-and-two-phase-displacement.txt): 658 abstracts. Keywords: capillary pressure, fluid, wettability, displacement, contact, phase
- [CO2 storage and trapping](https://mralbu.github.io/interpore-papers/llms/co2-storage-and-trapping.txt): 511 abstracts. Keywords: co2, storage, trapping, carbon, injection, dissolution
- [Imaging, digital rock and pore networks](https://mralbu.github.io/interpore-papers/llms/imaging-digital-rock-and-pore-networks.txt): 480 abstracts. Keywords: images, rock, image, digital, pore, resolution
- [Shale gas, kerogen and adsorption](https://mralbu.github.io/interpore-papers/llms/shale-gas-kerogen-and-adsorption.txt): 376 abstracts. Keywords: shale gas, pore, adsorption, pores, organic, kerogen
- [Mixing, dispersion and reactive transport](https://mralbu.github.io/interpore-papers/llms/mixing-dispersion-and-reactive-transport.txt): 370 abstracts. Keywords: mixing, reactive transport, solute, dispersion, reaction, reactions

## Data

- [All abstracts, one line each](https://mralbu.github.io/interpore-papers/llms-full.txt): ID, year, title, authors and mini-symposium, grouped by topic
- [papers.json](https://mralbu.github.io/interpore-papers/data/papers.json): metadata, map coordinates, topics and similar-abstract links
- [abstracts.json](https://mralbu.github.io/interpore-papers/data/abstracts.json): abstract text by ID
- [history.json](https://mralbu.github.io/interpore-papers/data/history.json): every meeting since 2009 with place, dates and per-meeting statistics

## Optional

- [InterPore](https://www.interpore.org/): the society
- [events.interpore.org](https://events.interpore.org/): the conference system
